notes: Table 0 is a combined SKU-level export: product name, currency, unit and price attributes repeat across two Location rows (KUL, JHB), while Available differs per SKU/location. It should yield one product per SKU with two inventory entries and one price entry per SKU.

Currency is explicitly MYR in all 24 rows; per operator instruction, no FX conversion should be applied.
Net price is explicitly VAT-exclusive because Tax included is 'No' in every row; Tax rate is explicitly 5%, to be represented as vat_rate 0.05.
Price list is explicitly 'standard' in every row; Sales unit is PCS in every row.

No source evidence supports pack_size, brand, barcode, category, status, description, effective dates, promotions, reserved quantity, or additional attributes, so those optional fields should remain unset rather than fabricated.
No blocking business question remains for the detected table; tax, currency, unit, price-list and location meanings are stated explicitly in the source or by the operator requirements.
